protocol.format: Controlled synthetic binary raster silhouettes at fixed lighting and view. No real photos or automatic segmentation.
protocol.trainedReference: Two intact, unit-scale T masks at 0 and 90 degrees. Each scene uses an independent run with the same seed and training input.
protocol.baseline: Fixed scale of 1. Score is the fraction of projected template cells occupied in the scene.
protocol.scaled: Identical foreground score, with all three scales available. The top alignment must be unique.
protocol.iou: Junction compares foreground intersection over union inside the tight bounding box of each projected template, without supplied visibility. Only this arm drives the downstream result probe.
protocol.knownMask: Separate oracle diagnostic. Uses foreground overlap on visible projected template cells with at least 60% of the template visible. The known mask is not used by any other arm.
protocol.cut: Pick the last correctly localized IoU-arm scene. Disable only the comparator input carrying C. The reference still travels and its energy is conserved.
protocol.cachedControl: Run the same comparator directly on the cached C measured at the distant probe and the exact input raster. Scores, selections, and the pulse drive are identical in every connected trial. For occluded scenes, replacing the oracle mask with an all-visible mask also leaves the three primary scores and the pulse drive identical.
protocol.judgment: A positive requires correct center, orientation, and scale. Accepted wrong poses are separate from negative-scene false positives.
